passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Mangrove forests grow along tropical coastlines.
• Their dense roots slow waves and trap sediment.
• A 2020 study estimated that mangroves prevent more than $65 billion in flood damage each year.
• About 35% of the world's mangroves were lost between 1980 and 2000.
stem: The student wants to emphasize the economic value of protecting mangroves to an audience of government officials. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: Mangroves prevent an estimated $65 billion in flood damage each year, a reason to protect forests that lost about 35% of their area between 1980 and 2000.
Mangrove forests, which grow along tropical coastlines around the world, have dense roots that slow incoming waves and trap sediment near the shore.
About 35% of the world's mangrove forests were lost between 1980 and 2000, according to estimates.
Because their roots slow waves and trap sediment, mangrove forests can grow along tropical coastlines.
steps: The goal: economic value plus protection.
Only the first choice uses the $65 billion figure and ties it to protecting forests that are being lost.
The others give biology, the loss alone or a reversed cause-and-effect.
key: For a persuasive goal, pick the choice that uses the most relevant figure for that audience.
